components.name: Service Row
components.description: Line-led selection row for a shop service; it replaces a card with visible lanes and a chevron.
components.css: .ds-service-row{width:100%;min-height:76px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr 24px;align-items:center;padding:13px 2px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #aab5b9;border-radius:0;background:rgba(244,245,241,.7);color:#15202b;text-align:left;font-family:Aptos,'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-service-icon{color:#0e4fc9;font-size:20px;font-weight:800}.ds-service-copy strong,.ds-service-copy small{display:block}.ds-service-copy strong{font-size:15px}.ds-service-copy small{margin-top:4px;color:#52616e;font-size:13px}.ds-chevron{font-size:24px}.ds-service-row:hover{background:#e7eef9}.ds-service-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1769ff;outline-offset:-3px}.ds-service-row:active{background:#c9dcff}

components.name: File Slot
components.description: Centered document-upload target bounded only by top and bottom rules.
components.css: .ds-file-slot{min-height:132px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-top:1px solid #97a5ac;border-bottom:1px solid #97a5ac;color:#163c7d;font-family:Aptos,'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-file-slot input{position:absolute;inline-size:1px;block-size:1px;opacity:0}.ds-file-slot strong{font-size:16px}.ds-file-slot span{color:#52616e;font-size:13px}.ds-file-slot:hover{background:#e7eef9}.ds-file-slot:focus-within{outline:3px solid #1769ff;outline-offset:-3px;background:#e7eef9}

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Adjacent square option cells for print settings such as colour and side.
components.css: .ds-segmented{min-height:44px;display:flex;font-family:Aptos,'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-segmented button{flex:1;border:1px solid #87959d;border-radius:0;background:#fbfcfa;color:#41525e;font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}.ds-segmented button+button{border-left:0}.ds-segmented .ds-segmented-selected{background:#dbe8ff;color:#09397f;font-weight:800}.ds-segmented button:hover{background:#e7eef9}.ds-segmented button:focus-visible{position:relative;outline:3px solid #1769ff;outline-offset:-3px}.ds-segmented button:active{background:#c9dcff}

components.name: Price Slip
components.description: Two-column operational price summary with receipt-weight rules instead of a card surface.
components.html: 1 pages · B&W · A4₹2Final amount is calculated by Sprint’s server.
components.css: .ds-price-slip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;column-gap:10px;row-gap:5px;margin:20px 0;padding:16px 0;border-top:2px solid #172636;border-bottom:1px solid #97a5ac;color:#15202b;font-family:Aptos,'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-price-slip span,.ds-price-slip small{color:#52616e;font-size:13px}.ds-price-slip strong{font-size:25px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.ds-price-slip small{grid-column:1/-1}.ds-price-slip:focus-within{outline:3px solid #1769ff;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Request Status Rail
components.description: A line-led live request timeline with clear completed and upcoming states.
components.css: .ds-status-rail{margin:0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid #aab5b9;list-style:none;color:#71808a;font-family:Aptos,'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-status-rail li{min-height:50px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #aab5b9;font-size:16px}.ds-status-rail li span{width:24px;display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-status-rail .ds-status-done{color:#176040;font-weight:700}.ds-status-rail li:hover{background:#e7eef9}.ds-status-rail li:focus-within{outline:3px solid #1769ff;outline-offset:-3px}

narrative.overview: Sprint’s customer surface applies Crouwel-inspired operational grid logic to a calm, accurately prepared service slip. It makes a neighborhood print counter feel organized and immediate: strong black-blue type, visible dividing rules, plain-language choices, and a single cobalt action make the next step obvious without turning a practical request into a flashy checkout. The system is mobile-first, dense enough to feel operational and generous enough to read quickly while standing at a counter. Its visual language is intentionally material-light: border lines, spacing, and paper-tone shifts establish order; almost every surface stays flat. The only translucent treatment is the restrained sticky topbar, which keeps shop context visible while preserving the paper field beneath it.
keyCharacteristics: Bright neutral paper field with a faint, precise construction grid.
Cobalt used as an operational signal for the primary route, icon accents, and key identifiers.
Square, rule-led controls that echo a printed service slip rather than a consumer card stack.
Compact system sans typography with tightly tracked, emphatic display type.
Direct status, privacy, and availability cues that feel trustworthy rather than decorative.

rules.name: The Cobalt Is an Instruction Rule
rules.body: Cobalt points to the action or operational fact that matters now; it is not a general decorative fill.

rules.name: The Grid Is Structure, Not a Gradient Rule
rules.body: Keep the faint construction-grid line pattern. Do not add decorative color gradients, glow fields, or tonal washes.

rules.name: The Narrow Question Rule
rules.body: Large prompts are questions for a customer in motion: short, left aligned, and never allowed to become a wide marketing headline.

rules.name: The One Working Column Rule
rules.body: Keep request-making, payment, and status tasks inside the narrow reading column even when the surrounding canvas is wide.

rules.name: The Flat Service Counter Rule
rules.body: If a boundary is needed, use a rule; do not solve it with cards, ambient shadows, or layered panels.

dos: Do retain the bright Counter Paper canvas and faint 24px construction grid on customer screens.
Do use Cobalt for the one main action, key request number, and functional icon emphasis.
Do make boundaries with the established 1px and 2px rules before considering another surface.
Do preserve 44px-minimum fields, 50px-minimum actions, visible 3px keyboard focus, and the reduced-motion override.
Do keep the topbar as the only sticky, blurred layer.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, pill buttons, glass panels, or general-purpose drop shadows.
Don't add decorative gradients, glow effects, or a second loud accent color.
Don't turn the narrow customer task column into a dashboard or a wide marketing layout.
Don't use green or red for ordinary decoration; they are state signals.
